reviews.comment:
Excelente lugar para un descanso Rutero, ideal para familia con niños, tiene juegos afuera y pelotero adentro, como para que descarguen la energía acumulada, en el viaje.
La limpieza siempre es óptima, tienen gran variedad de productos y todos de calidad...
Es una parada de rutina, para nuestra familia...

(Translated by Google)
Excellent place for a roadside rest stop, ideal for families with children. It has an outdoor playground and an indoor ball pit, perfect for them to burn off all that pent-up energy from the trip.
The cleanliness is always impeccable, and they have a wide variety of high-quality products. It's a regular stop for our family.
